title: catalyst validate
description: What `catalyst validate --json` prints: whether the deployment's documents pass, and each finding (catalyst >= 0.95.0 describes it). `ok` is false when a finding is an error, or any finding with `--strict`.

code.description: What kind of finding it is, e.g. `required-field`, `enum-value`, `rule-strength`.

where.description: The file it is about, relative to the criterion, or the document.
